proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10991 *laṣṭi gives Nepali lāṭho and Hindi/Bhojpuri lāṭhī stick, alongside MIA laṭṭhi. The survey laṭ(h)i/laṭṭhi forms fit the stick family; the remote lakuṭa/yaṣṭi crossing remains tentative. Exact survey form laṭhi is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
